# Apoozo

> Apoozo is a wedding video editing service for videographers. Videographers upload their raw footage and receive a finished, audio-driven wedding film in 7-10 days. Apoozo only edits; it does not shoot weddings.

## Services and pricing (USD)
- Wedding reel, 30-60 seconds: $120
- Wedding highlight film: $275
- Full wedding film, 45-60 minutes: $540
- Turnaround: 7-10 days, usually within the first week
- Fully remote; works with videographers worldwide

- [About](https://apoozofilms.com/about.html): the editing approach (real audio, interviews, toasts)
